programme.title: The Twelve
programme.desc: When Nathan lies under oath about the affair, an enraged Kate refuses Colby's advice not to testify - but will the secret between Kate and her sister explode under the pressure of the revelations? Simon's priorities are put to the test when his daughter goes missing. Meanwhile, Farrad is forced to seek help for his wife in a place he cannot hope to find it. Sam Neill stars

programme.title: Unwind with STV
programme.desc: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern meets Arthur, a 12-year-old rescue cat with diabetes whose owner, Kerina, is using the latest technology to monitor her pet's blood sugar levels. Vet Amy performs surgery to remove a lump from King Charles Spaniel Eddie. James neuters a dog who has been rescued from Macedonia, and Fern also helps out when young Cavapoo Mila gets preventative treatment

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Royal Kitchen Gardens
programme.desc: The chef heads to Castle of Mey in Caithness, once home to Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother and now a treasured place to King Charles. Head gardener Chris tells Raymond about the history of the walled garden and reveals how they grow produce in such a challenging location, while chef Martin cooks an Aberdeen Angus fillet steak with seasonal vegetables from the gardens

programme.title: M&S: Dress the Nation
programme.desc: AJ Odudu and Vernon Kay host as nine amateur designers go head to head in a competition to win a dream job as a fashion designer for high street giant M&S. The designers are thrown in at the deep end as they are tasked with creating womenswear to be judged by guest expert Jade Jagger, Director of Womenswear at M&S Maddy Evans and store customers

programme.desc: The chef is joined by singer-songwriter Amy Macdonald and chefs Cyrus Todiwala and Meliz Berg

programme.desc: Joining Alan at Manor Farm this time are theatre producer Cameron Mackintosh, Midsomer Murders star Annette Badland and actor Milo Parker. Dee Hart-Dyke takes us around her impressive garden, horticulturalist Camilla Bassett-Smith opens up the pages of her December diary, and there are some very sticky liqueurs in the Best of British feature

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern meets a German Shorthaired Pointer puppy who has bitten off more than she can chew and helps vet James with Badger, a handsome but nervous cat who is in for a routine vaccination. Fern Britton presents the series where she meets the owners of beloved pets who have appointments at The Grove Vets. Can any of them come out on top? Bradley Walsh hosts

John and Fiona attempt to maintain the appearance of a contented life in front of their friends, but old wounds resurface and it's not long before Tommy shows up to their dinner unannounced. Thriller, starring Andrew Lincoln, Indira Varma, Ewen Bremner and Eve Myles
